mono.usage: For data tables, VAB metrics, currency (EUR), percentages

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Tight padding for data density. p-4 or p-6 for widgets.
layout_and_spacing.borders: 1px solid borders (border-border), no soft shadows. Sharp and objective.

components.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border, no shadow. Hover: slight border color darken.
components.tables: Dense. Use IBM Plex Mono for numbers. Right-align currency columns.
components.buttons: Sharp edges. High contrast. Primary buttons in International Klein Blue.
components.navigation: Sticky top nav or dense left sidebar. Must include Cmd+K search pattern.
components.forms: Left-aligned labels. Use Shadcn components heavily. Validation in Portuguese.
components.data_testid: MANDATORY on all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='submit-proposal-btn').

images.description: Modern building facade with reflective glass panels
Professional headshot for CEO or Manager
Professional headshot for Sales Rep or Admin

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the UI using Shadcn and Tailwind CSS.
Ensure all text, labels, and placeholders are in Portuguese (PT-PT).
VAB (Valor Acrescentado Bruto) must be prominently displayed alongside Total Value in Dashboards, Proposals, and Orders.
Currency formatting must be in EUR (€) using IBM Plex Mono.
Include 'data-testid' attributes on all inputs, buttons, and critical UI elements for testing.
Follow the Control Room grid pattern for the Dashboard: dense, functional, cardless (1px borders, no shadows).
Use Cmd+K global search pattern for quick access to entities.
Avoid the 'Inter' font. Use Cabinet Grotesk for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body.
Use Phosphor icons. Command: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react
Ensure the Funnel visualization uses the specific colors outlined in colors.funnel_stages.
